# AISneer

> Independent laptop discovery site. We curate spec-verified laptops and USB hubs, then link to manufacturer or retailer listings. We do not hold inventory.

Site: https://www.aisneer.com
Contact: hello@aisneer.com
Canonical host: https://www.aisneer.com

## What we publish

- Curated laptop picks across ultrabook, gaming, business, creator, student, Chromebook, and workstation categories
- Individual laptop spec pages at /laptops/{slug} (400+ words, manufacturer deal URL)
- Category hubs (gaming, business, student, ultrabook, creator, and others)
- USB-C hubs and laptop accessories
- Laptop buying guides, led by creator laptops under $1,500

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://www.aisneer.com/): How AISneer works, featured laptops, buying guide, FAQ
- [Shop laptops](https://www.aisneer.com/laptops): Full catalog with spec URLs
- [About](https://www.aisneer.com/about): Editors, how we pick laptops, affiliate disclosure
- [Privacy](https://www.aisneer.com/privacy)
- [Terms](https://www.aisneer.com/terms)
- [Gaming laptops](https://www.aisneer.com/laptops/category/gaming)
- [Business laptops](https://www.aisneer.com/laptops/category/business)
- [Student laptops](https://www.aisneer.com/laptops/category/student)
- [USB hubs](https://www.aisneer.com/usb-hubs)
- [Blog](https://www.aisneer.com/blog): Laptop buying guides only in the public cluster

## Notes for crawlers

- Canonical host is https://www.aisneer.com (apex 301s here)
- XML sitemap: https://www.aisneer.com/sitemap.xml
- IndexNow key: https://www.aisneer.com/7b3e9c4a1f8d2e6b0c5a9d4f1e8b3c7a.txt
- Product links may be affiliate links (rel=sponsored)
- Main content is in HTML, not behind login or consent walls
- FAQ answers are visible in page HTML
- Off-topic accessory posts are noindex and omitted from this file
